summary: The local-chart path in resolve_helm_args.py now resolves through the resolved chart name at all three mis-keyed sites — get_chart_args' routing test plus get_helm_images' values.yaml read and templates/ walk — so a release whose `chart:` overrides its config directory name resolves locally instead of falling through to the upstream repo path. Four tests ride along (three routing cases with both paths stubbed, one hermetic get_helm_images assert), each site mutation-checked; `kc project test` is green at 53 tests. Provably inert today: the only `chart:` in the whole tree is configs/dev/_ci/prd/release.yaml's falsy `chart: null`.
